fees.notes: UCSF official Programme Fee Information (International Student) 2023: BA (Hons) in Development Studies with Media Communication tuition USD 10,000 total. Additional one-off fees: application USD200, processing USD1,555; annual recurring visa renewal USD200, insurance USD155, resource fee USD400. International students pay in advance the equivalent of 30 credits annually. Source: https://www.ucsf.edu.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/UCSF-PROGRAMME-FEE-2023-INTERNATIONAL.pdf, fetched 2026-09-18.
